title: Fee Submission Deadline Extended for Fall 2025 and Spring 2026
text:
Fee Submission Deadline Extension

In response to requests from the parents, the administration has approved an extension for tuition fee payments for the upcoming academic year. This extension applies to both the
Fall 2025
and
Spring 2026
semesters.

New Submission Deadline

February 8, 2026

All payments must be received by 11:59 PM

Important Notice

To ensure uninterrupted enrollment and avoid late payment penalties, students must complete their fee payments by the revised deadline. Payment options and detailed instructions are available through the
University Student Portal
.

Office of the Treasurer

This notice supersedes all previous communications regarding fee deadlines
